name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Training Loop
definition: Per-image error: Compares one render against one photo. Scene-wide error is the loss averaged across all training views, used to monitor overall progress.
summary: The 3D Gaussian Splatting Training Loop is an iterative optimization process that minimizes photometric error by adjusting 3D Gaussian parameters using standard stochastic gradient descent with a fixed iteration budget and explicit densification heuristics.
